name: Self-Sponsorship Residence Permit and Return Visa (Foreign Investor)

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum BHD 100,000 shareholding in a Bahrain-registered enterprise, linked to a valid Commercial Registration (CR).
requirements.fix_path: Register or acquire a qualifying shareholding.

requirements.blocker_text: Stable income of at least BHD 500/month; valid CR, medical insurance, and a good-conduct certificate also required.

sources.title: Nationality, Passports and Residence Affairs (NPRA), Bahrain -- Self-Sponsorship Residence Permit and Return Visa (Foreign Investor): minimum BHD 100,000 shareholding, stable income >= BHD 500/month, valid CR, medical insurance, good-conduct certificate; fees BHD 200 (2yr)/400 (5yr)/600 (10yr) + BHD 5 application + BHD 250 visa-transfer fee; 40 working-day processing

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bahrain). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 NPRA sourced. This is distinct from bh_permanent_residence.json (Golden Residency), which has its own, separate and lower property-investment threshold (BHD 130,000 in real estate, not business shareholding) -- the two should not be conflated even though both ultimately grant long-duration residence. pr_after_months (60) and citizenship_after_months (180) are cross-referenced from adjacent files, not independently sourced here.
